mapper.select: /* SQL ID : SmnrFdbkDAO.smnrFdbkList 설 명 : 세미나피드백목록 */ SELECT FDBK.* , FN_REF_FILE_CNT(FDBK.SMNR_FDBK_ID) AS FILE_CNT FROM TB_LMS_SMNR_FDBK FDBK WHERE FDBK.SMNR_ID = #{smnrId} AND FDBK.USER_ID = #{userId} AND FDBK.DELYN = 'N'
mapper.update: /* SQL ID : SmnrFdbkDAO.smnrFdbkModify 설 명 : 세미나피드백수정 */ MERGE INTO TB_LMS_SMNR_FDBK FDBK USING ( SELECT #{smnrFdbkId} AS SMNR_FDBK_ID , #{smnrId} AS SMNR_ID , #{userId} AS USER_ID , #{fdbkCts} AS FDBK_CTS , #{rgtrId} AS RGTR_ID FROM DUAL ) USR ON ( FDBK.SMNR_FDBK_ID = USR.SMNR_FDBK_ID AND FDBK.USER_ID = USR.USER_ID ) WHEN MATCHED THEN UPDATE SET FDBK.FDBK_CTS = USR.FDBK_CTS , FDBK.MDFR_ID = USR.RGTR_ID , FDBK.MOD_DTTM = FN_DTTM() WHEN NOT MATCHED THEN INSERT ( SMNR_FDBK_ID , SMNR_ID , USER_ID , FDBK_CTS , RGTR_ID , REG_DTTM ) VALUES ( USR.SMNR_FDBK_ID , USR.SMNR_ID , USR.USER_ID , USR.FDBK_CTS , USR.RGTR_ID , FN_DTTM() )
mapper.select: /* SQL ID : SmnrFdbkDAO.smnrFdbkSelect 설 명 : 세미나피드백조회 */ SELECT FDBK.* , FN_REF_FILE_CNT(FDBK.SMNR_FDBK_ID) AS FILE_CNT FROM TB_LMS_SMNR_FDBK FDBK WHERE FDBK.SMNR_FDBK_ID = #{smnrFdbkId} AND FDBK.DELYN = 'N'
